Hi Mark,

Thanks for letting me know, and good luck with them. A small padded Amazon parcel like that usually gets set aside rather than thrown out, so there is a fair chance they still have it.

Keep me posted either way. If they cannot find it or they will not send it on, write back here and I will take it from there with the team so you are not left without a working screen.

Thanks for your patience with all of this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
